### [Tiling Space Cosmology](tiling-space-cosmology.qmd)

Emergent cosmological scaling $a(n) \asymp n^{5/6}$ derived and numerically tested from shell-by-shell $E_8$ quasicrystal growth (`arXiv:2407.14520`).

### [$E_8$ Cycle Clock Analysis](e8-cycle-clock.qmd)

Procedural $C_5$ and $C_4$ clock dynamics on the 10-shell decomposition of $E_8$ isolating $\mathfrak{su}(3)$, $\mathfrak{u}(4)$, and $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ stabilizers in $\mathrm{Spin}(8)$.
</div>
[Open Project →](e8-cycle-clock.qmd)
